faqs.q: Sec. 78-38. - Post-hearing procedure; decision by council to proceed.
faqs.a:
After the hearing, after the council has disposed of all complaints, protests and
               objections, verbal and in writing, the council shall determine whether to proceed
               with the improvement district and with each assessment unit therein, if there be more
               than one.
(Code 1981, § 27-39; Ord. No. 551, § 16(A), 5-14-1964)
